# PesaGuard Developer Documentation

> Technical documentation for developers integrating with the PesaGuard API and reconciliation platform.

This documentation is a rolling set of guides. The OpenAPI document served by the deployment you are authorized to use is authoritative over the checked-in mirror.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/getting-started/quickstart): verify an API deployment and retrieve its contract.
- [Getting started](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/getting-started/): provisioning, first requests, and production checklist.
- [Authentication](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/api/authentication): bearer tokens, API keys, and provider callback boundaries.
- [Environment guide](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/environments/): staging and production distinctions.
- [OpenAPI reference](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/api-reference/): interactive contract browser and JSON/YAML downloads.

## Build and operate

- [API guides](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/api/): errors, pagination, filtering, idempotency, rate limits, and versioning.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/webhooks/): event catalog, verification, retries, and delivery guidance.
- [Reconciliation](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/reconciliation/): matching, exceptions, and reports.
- [SDK guidance](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/sdks/): language-specific HTTP client patterns. No official SDK is claimed unless a page explicitly says otherwise.
- [Security](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/security/): API-key handling, tenant boundaries, and responsible disclosure.
- [Troubleshooting and support](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/support/): gather request IDs and redacted evidence.
- [Changelog](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/changelog/): documentation and contract notes.

## Contract and capability boundaries

- Public resource routes use the `/api/v1` prefix. The checked-in Dashboard OpenAPI document has `info.version` `2.0.0`; that document version does not mean the public API is v2.
- The OpenAPI mirror may lag a deployment. Compare it with that deployment's `/openapi.json`.
- There is no public self-serve PesaGuard sandbox signup described here. Staging access is provisioned and must be verified with the pilot team.
- Documentation pages distinguish implemented behavior from planned behavior. A UI, route, or schema alone is not evidence that payment processing or production readiness has been verified.
- Never put credentials, customer data, or provider secrets into documentation examples, issue reports, or browser-based tools.

These links identify the intended product domains; this file does not assert DNS, deployment, uptime, or API reachability.


## Detailed integration playbooks
- [Platform lifecycle and architecture](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/platform-lifecycle): boundaries across developer access, Core API, Dashboard and backend services.
- [API authentication and credential safety](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/api-authentication): authentication, authorization, secret storage, rotation and environment isolation.
- [Customer Dashboard integration](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/dashboard-integration): tenant-safe reads and mutations, UI states, pagination and browser security.
- [Reconciliation operations](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/reconciliation-operations): input normalization, matching, exception resolution and metrics.
- [Webhook engineering](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/webhook-engineering): signature verification, idempotent consumers, retries and replay.
- [Production go-live](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/production-go-live): release gates, security, observability and recovery evidence.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/troubleshooting): diagnostics for HTTP, authentication, reconciliation and webhook failures.

Platform links: [Developer Platform](https://developers.pesaguard.co.ke/), [Core API](https://api.pesaguard.co.ke/), [Customer Dashboard](https://app.pesaguard.co.ke/).


## Customer and operational handbooks
- [Customer Dashboard operations](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/customer-dashboard-operations): transaction investigation, reconciliation exceptions, reports, roles and safe escalation.
- [Data quality and ingestion](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/data-quality-and-ingestion): source completeness, schema validation, normalization, duplicate handling and freshness monitoring.
- [Risk alerts and fraud review](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/risk-alerts-and-fraud-review): signal triage, evidence, false positives, escalation and auditability.
- [M-Pesa integration guide](https://docs.pesaguard.co.ke/guides/mpesa-integration-guide): callback safety, idempotency, reconciliation and production testing.
